description.value: A heritage museum and archives in the heart of the Pemberton Valley, on the traditional territory of the Lil'wat and St'át'imc Nations, collecting and sharing the region's history since 1982. The site includes a historic schoolhouse and features exhibits on logging, railways, and pioneer life. Admission is by donation, making it an easy and worthwhile stop for touring cyclists passing through Pemberton on the Sea-to-Sky corridor.
